Subject: Mid-contract top-up + co-term ask

Hey Lauren —

Quick one: we’ve seen an unexpected product traffic spike and are going to need an incremental capacity top-up for Q3 (roughly +200k tokens / month for the next 3 months). Our finance team wants to co-term this with our renewal so everything ends Jan 31 2025.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm what discount/credit you can offer for a short bridge top-up?
- What’s the fastest path to get this signed (PO vs amendment vs DocuSign)?

I’ve attached a quick forecast (Optera_usage_forecast_Q3.xlsx). If we can get a reasonable concession here, we’ll route a PO immediately.

Thanks —
Celia Morris
Head of Data Platform
Optera

Hi Celia —

Thanks for the heads-up and the forecast. We can absolutely help; wanted to outline two pragmatic options so you can pick what fits Optera’s procurement timeline:

Option A (fastest):
- One-time bridge credit equal to 9% of the incremental committed spend for the 3-month top-up.
- Amendment that co-terms the top-up to Jan 31 2025.
- Requires signed amendment or PO within 10 business days.

Option B (bigger commitment):
- 12% blended discount in exchange for a 12-month commitment on the increased baseline (annualized).
- Co-term to Jan 31 2025 included.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Tell me which option you prefer and confirm monthly cadence.
2) If Option A, we’ll generate a short amendment (attached: Draft_Amendment_v1.pdf) and Ben will handle pricing signoff.
3) If Option B, we’ll route to Finance for final approval (typical turnaround 48–72 hrs).

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through. When works for you?

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Renewals & Expansion
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mid-contract top-up + co-term ask — pricing recommendation

Looping in pricing/ops for a quick read. My recommendation for Optera:

- Approve Option A but tighten the language to a one-time 9% credit applied to the top-up tranches (this preserves unit economics).
- Require PO or countersigned amendment within 10 business days; if missed, credit rescinds and we revert to pay-as-you-go.
- Add a short SLA side-letter guaranteeing latency targets for the top-up period; if SLA misses occur, customer receives service credits up to 5% (capped).

Attached: SOW-topup.xlsx (breaks incremental usage into monthly buckets).

If Finance is comfortable with 9% (and confirms cap), we can send Draft_Amendment_v2.pdf out for signature and include DocuSign envelope.

—Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Expansion
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW-topup.xlsx (spreadsheet, 14KB)

Thanks everyone — confirmed from Finance: we can make a one-time exception up to 10% for bridge top-ups where a PO or countersigned amendment is provided within 10 business days. Conditions:

- Credit: up to 10% applied to incremental committed spend (one-time).
- Term alignment: amendment must explicitly co-term to 2025-01-31.
- SLA side-letter required for any credit > 7%.
- PO must be receipted (or DocuSign envelope completed) within 10 business days, otherwise the credit is void.

Lauren — please send Draft_Amendment_v2.pdf (I’ve updated the finance block) and include the DocuSign link below so Optera can sign directly. I’ll add the final approval note to the HubSpot deal.
